desc: This Trifecta-design flash hider suppresses excess visual flash on SBRs and full-auto firearms. These Internal Flash Hider Front Caps ship standard with Velos LBP Series suppressors. Front Caps are designed to switch easily between different calibers, this cap ensures optimal performance for both suppressors and MAAD brakes. Using correct front caps will reduce dB levels between 2 to 5 dB on a suppressor.
